headline: On last trading day, Nifty gained 75 points while Sensex slipped into red after volatile trade and CAS adjustments.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Nifty 50 gained 75 points as certain sectors showed strength during the last session.
Sensex slipped into the red following the Closing Auction Session (CAS) adjustments.
Mixed global market signals led to a volatile trading environment for Indian benchmarks.
Smallcap stocks provided a cushion to the market, outperforming the main Sensex index.
whatHappening: NTPC has terminated a Rs 400 crore storage project previously awarded to GR Infraprojects.
Rapido has filed an insolvency plea against Magicpin over alleged unpaid operational dues.
Paytm is being closely watched by investors following its recent market performance and opening trends.
The RBI has ordered the removal of several officials from the Latur DCC Bank.

summary: The Indian stock market concluded its last session with Nifty gaining 75 points while the Sensex slipped into the red. Markets are currently closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Tuesday, September 22. Investors are monitoring corporate developments including project terminations and legal disputes involving major firms.
